description: Automated and manual audit rules for the Avatar component

rules.title: Root class required
rules.description: Every avatar element must have the .avatar base class
rules.check: Element uses avatar styling without .avatar base class

rules.title: Size modifier required
rules.description: Every .avatar element must have exactly one size modifier
rules.check: .avatar element is missing a size modifier (.avatar--24 through .avatar--120)
rules.fix: Add the appropriate size modifier for the intended avatar dimension

rules.title: Multiple size modifiers forbidden
rules.description: .avatar must not carry more than one size modifier simultaneously
rules.check: .avatar element has more than one .avatar--{size} class
rules.fix: Remove all but one size modifier

rules.title: Image type requires child
rules.description: .avatar--image must contain an child element

rules.title: Image alt text required
rules.description: must have a non-empty alt attribute
rules.check: img.avatar__image has empty or missing alt attribute
rules.fix: Add alt attribute with the person's name: alt='Person Name'

rules.title: Icon/Initials type requires identity label
rules.description: .avatar with icon or initials content must have role='img' and aria-label when conveying identity
rules.fix: Add role='img' aria-label='Person Name' to the .avatar root element

rules.title: Icon must be aria-hidden
rules.description: .avatar__icon span and its SVG child must be aria-hidden

rules.title: Initials span must be aria-hidden
rules.description: .avatar__initials must be aria-hidden since the label is on the root element

rules.title: Overflow counter must be aria-hidden
rules.description: .avatar--overflow element must be aria-hidden; count is conveyed by group aria-label

rules.title: Avatar Group requires role and label
rules.description: .avatar-group must have role='group' and descriptive aria-label
rules.fix: Add role='group' aria-label='N team members' to .avatar-group

rules.title: Group must have layout modifier
rules.fix: Add .avatar-group--stacked or .avatar-group--flat to the group element

rules.title: Initials length constraint
rules.description: Initials text should be 1–2 characters maximum
rules.check: .avatar__initials contains more than 2 non-whitespace characters (excluding overflow '+N' pattern)

rules.title: No hardcoded color values
rules.description: avatar.css must not contain hardcoded hex or rgba color values outside var() fallbacks
rules.check: avatar.css selector contains color property with hardcoded value not inside var()
rules.fix: Replace hardcoded color with var(--avatar-token, #fallback) pattern

rules.title: No cross-namespace token direct usage
rules.description: avatar.css must not reference --Button-* tokens directly in primary property values
rules.check: avatar.css uses --Button-* as a primary (non-fallback) custom property
rules.fix: Define --avatar-bg-default in token.css and reference it in avatar.css

rules.title: Square 120px uses larger radius
rules.fix: Ensure CSS specificity rule .avatar--square.avatar--120 sets correct border-radius

rules.title: Avatar Group nesting forbidden
rules.description: .avatar-group must not be nested inside another .avatar-group
